Bhringraj Powder Exporter: Introduction to Bhringraj Powder

Bhringraj powder is the dried, finely ground leaf of Eclipta alba, bought mainly by hair care, cosmetic and herbal formulation brands. Tradenest Naturals works as a bhringraj powder exporter and bhringraj powder manufacturer India, supplying buyers in the USA, UK, Canada and Europe. Our raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. Each batch is dehydrated and milled with care to keep its natural green colour and characteristic herbal aroma.

Manufacturing and Quality Standards

Production takes place in our FSSAI licensed facility under documented food-safety practices. We start by selecting mature bhringraj leaves. The leaves are then dehydrated under controlled conditions and milled to a fine, even powder. As a bulk bhringraj powder supplier, we keep the standard grade free from added colours, fillers and chemical additives. Moisture and particle size are checked on each batch. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Key Specifications and Formulation

The standard grade is milled to 100 mesh, which gives smooth dispersion in oils, pastes and powder blends. Our bhringraj powder bulk grade has moisture of 8% or less, which helps limit caking in storage. Shelf life is 24 months in sealed packs kept cool and dry. The single-herb profile suits hair care, cosmetic and traditional Ayurvedic and herbal formulations.

Applications Across Industries

Buyers in several sectors use this powder for product development. Personal care brands add it to herbal hair oils, shampoos, conditioners and scalp products. Cosmetic formulators use it in face packs, clay masks and herbal soaps. Herbal and supplement companies use it in traditional Ayurvedic blends and capsule formulations. Many buyers start with a small trial and then ask for our pure bhringraj powder price for regular volumes.

Buyer Value and Wholesale Partnership

Working with Tradenest Naturals gives you practical commercial benefits. We offer flexible batch sizes, samples on request and custom packaging. As an IEC registered exporter, we provide export documentation support and ship worldwide from India. Whether you need a private label bhringraj powder manufacturer for OEM packing or a steady B2B bhringraj powder exporter India for bulk shipments, we will plan a supply that fits your business.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • What is the minimum order quantity for bhringraj powder? The MOQ is 5 Kg, so you can place a trial order before committing to larger volumes.
  • What are the packaging and shelf-life options? We pack in food-grade export bags and drums, with private label packs available. Shelf life is 24 months when stored cool and dry.
  • How do I request a sample or quote? Contact our sales team with your quantity, packaging and destination. We will send a quotation with the product specification sheet and arrange a sample.
